preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[v] <= 10**9 for v in range(1, N+1))
preconditions.description: Each element in array A must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for v, x in updates)
preconditions.description: All update queries must specify valid vertices and values within the range [1, N] and [1, 1,000,000,000].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N for v in queries)
preconditions.description: All query vertices must be valid and within the range [1, N].
The number of edges must be exactly N-1, forming a valid tree.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(vis[u] for u in subtree(v)) % (10**9 + 7))
postconditions.description: For each query of type 2, the output must be the sum of vis values in the subtree of v modulo 1,000,000,007.

invariants.expression: all(vis[u] >= 0 for u in range(1, N+1))
invariants.description: The vis array must contain non-negative values for all vertices.

invariants.expression: all(A[v] >= 1 for v in range(1, N+1))
invariants.description: The array A must contain values greater than or equal to 1 for all vertices.
